description: Read one Wisty UI item to choose and compose it: its install command, examples by name, When to use, When not to use, Usage, Rules, API reference.

sections.description: Only these parts, under the title and install command. Without it, the parts above; the rest, on how the item already behaves, come only when named here.

source.description: Add the installable files, for reading or copying by hand. Rarely needed: install with the shadcn command.

style.description: The "style" in the project's components.json, like "radix-nova" or "base-nova": it picks the Radix or Base UI version. Leave it out for the Radix version.

name: get_component
title: Read a Wisty UI item
